### Will You Open the Door? - The Crosswalk Devotional - February 24
Author: Megan J. Conner
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/will-you-open-the-door-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Revelation 3:20
Points:
- God often feels absent in difficult seasons, but perceived distance is usually an illusion because He remains near.
- Christ gently knocks and calls to the heart, never forcing or battering His way inside.
- Distrust and emotional distance usually develop when life outcomes do not meet personal expectations.
- Experiencing intimate fellowship with the Lord requires actively opening the heart through surrender and faith.

### Open Your Heart to Jesus - Homeword - December 4
Author: Jim Burns
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/open-your-heart-to-jesus-homeword-december-4.html
Passage: Revelation 3:20
Points:
- Enduring joy, contentment, and soul-level peace come solely from personal faith in Jesus Christ.
- Opening the door to Jesus involves decisive repentance and receiving Him as Savior.
- Christ continually works to bring healing, comfort, and restoration to broken and troubled lives.
- Entering into relationship and communion with Jesus leaves a person permanently transformed.
